none: PAS CAM-DE2553: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of Valens, AD364-378
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE] ; D/ D N VALEN-[...]AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Valens, AD364-378. Mint is Rome, AD367-375, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left. See LRBC, p.61, no.725. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N VALEN-[...]AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[SM]leaf R[...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.60g,…
